sections.label: Support for food caterers
sections.summary: Caterers receive 60% wage support under the Jobs Support Scheme, and Enterprise Singapore's grant helps them transform and diversify.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry how does the Ministry intend to support food caterers with their slower recovery compared to other F&B businesses.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: That is why under the support package for Phase Two (Heightened Alert), all F&B businesses, including caterers, will receive 60% wage support under the Jobs Support Scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: However, even as we gradually reopen the economy in a safe manner, caterers may not be able to revert entirely to their pre-pandemic modes of operation as consumer preferences change.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: This is why we have been encouraging and supporting food caterers to embark on transformation efforts and develop new business models or diversify into new businesses.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: With funding support from Enterprise Singapore's Enterprise Development Grant (EDG), the company launched their cloud kitchen concept and virtual brand "Gourmet Xpress", which offers ready-to-eat products.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The EDG and other Government schemes work together to help our companies diversify their businesses, deepen their capabilities and develop talent.
